title: The first-touch cookie keeps only the referring site and a clean landing path, on a Secure cookie

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system, report https://claude.ai/artifact/3sCikNdCHC9khmwCJbubfk)

detail: Wave 3 of the permission-first contact plan (finding 6). buildFirstTouch stores up to 300 characters of the full referrer URL, query string included, for 90 days, and proxy.ts sets the cookie without Secure. Work: keep only the referrer's hostname, keep the landing path without its query string, set secure: true. HttpOnly is a second step: the cookie banner clears it in the browser today, so the server has to clear it on a 'no' first. Code only. Filed 2026-11-20 by the verification sweep: the plan named this id but no row existed.

verify.note: Fails until buildFirstTouch keeps only the referrer hostname and proxy.ts sets the cookie Secure.
